english: When the Day of Pentecost had fully come, they were all with one accord in one place.
chiru: Pentecost ni kha hawng shok phakhan, amani kholok kha mun `khat ah mulung khatte a ruawm uh.

english: And suddenly there came a sound from heaven, as of a rushing mighty wind, and it filled the whole house where they were sitting.
chiru: Khan jetboithieiboi a helehoi kha ravan ah put ah rithirang ang a jong a, rushutna u inshung kholok kha jong miship.

english: Then there appeared to them divided tongues, as of fire, and one sat upon each of them.
chiru: Mieliei hai kha na mieichon ang a amani dieng jong lar.

english: And they were all filled with the Holy Spirit and began to speak with other tongues, as the Spirit gave them utterance.
chiru: Khahaikha na jong reshen ua, amani rikip dieng jong chutna uh. Khan Ratha Riethieng na jong miship ua, Ratha na baishona irupek u le roroia, amani kholok na chawngshik a achawng ruput u joi.

english: And there were dwelling in Jerusalem Jews, devout men, from every nation under heaven.
chiru: Kha mun khan ramram ah awm phung rikip ah put ah richichawi Jihudi hai kha Jerusalem ah ruawm uh.

english: And when this sound occurred, the multitude came together, and were confused, because everyone heard them speak in his own language.
chiru: Makhan helehoi kha rujet u phakhan, mipui kha vak ruchun ua, shindawngna runiei uh. Ajarla tirtawn rikip na amama phung chawng a achawng rujet uh.

english: Then they were all amazed and marveled, saying to one another, Look, are not all these who speak Galileans?
chiru: Shindawng le amramalam a amani na khatlekhat dieng rurierieina uh, Enro, achawng miring kholok khaw Galilee miring hai nih u mak maw?

english: And how is it that we hear, each in our own language in which we were born?
chiru: Itia kieini na nojongshokna u phung chawng rikip a nijet u hi?

english: Parthians and Medes and Elamites, those dwelling in Mesopotamia, Judea and Cappadocia, Pontus and Asia,
chiru: Parthia, Mede, Elam miring hai, khan Mesopotamia, Judea le Cappadocia, Pontus le Asia ram ah awm miring hai,

english: Phrygia and Pamphylia, Egypt and the parts of Libya adjoining Cyrene, visitors from Rome, both Jews and proselytes,
chiru: Phyrgia le Pamphylia, Egypt, khan Cyrene le ranai Lybia shie `khat, khan Rome ah put ah khomijin hai, Jihudi hai le phungtho hai dire,

english: Cretans and Arabs - we hear them speaking in our own tongues the wonderful works of God.
chiru: Crete tuikawram le Arab miring hai, kieini na Pathien chon thaw hai rekhek kha nawchawngtak a nijet u inih.

english: So they were all amazed and perplexed, saying to one another, Whatever could this mean?
chiru: Amani kholok shindawng le amramalam a khatlekhat dieng ruti uh, Mahi ih itina maw nih?

english: Others mocking said, They are full of new wine.
chiru: Eshen na erawh a ruti uh, Amani khaw juning le aship u keng.

english: But Peter, standing up with the eleven, raised his voice and said to them, Men of Judea and all who dwell in Jerusalem, let this be known to you, and heed my words.
chiru: Inia Peter na shawmlieikhat le ding a amani dieng he rashangtak a ruriei, Judea le Jerusalem ah awm miring hai, mahi nangijet u nih rosho, khan kawchawng hai hi rangairep u roh.

english: For these are not drunk, as you suppose, since it is only the third hour of the day.
chiru: Hihai miring hi nangimining u kha ang a, jukhawp nih u mak. Jingkar nidan kobak cholai.

english: But this is what was spoken by the prophet Joel:
chiru: Inia mahi thiempulien Joel dieng irureina kha inih:

english: And it shall come to pass in the last days, says God, That I will pour out of My Spirit on all flesh; Your sons and your daughters shall prophesy, Your young men shall see visions, Your old men shall dream dreams.
chiru: Nikho dawng khan hitihin awm rangnih. Makhala, karatha kha miring kholok shung a thong pe rang kanih. Nang shapa u hai le nang shanu u hai na chawng rophong u rangnih. Nang khangdawng u hai na mulungmik muk u rangnih, khan nang khanglui u hai na ramang raman u rangnih.

english: And on My menservants and on My maidservants I will pour out My Spirit in those days; And they shall prophesy.
chiru: Kha nikho hai khan koshok hai nupang apa diengshe karatha thong pe rang kanih. Amani na chawng rophong u rangnih.

english: I will show wonders in heaven above And signs in the earth beneath: Blood and fire and vapor of smoke.
chiru: Chung ravan a rekhekchon hai le noi rieliei a jetna hai kha mumuk rang kanih. Khahaikha thishen, miei, khan mieikhu ruhu nih rangnih.

english: The sun shall be turned into darkness, And the moon into blood, Before the coming of the great and awesome day of the Lord.
chiru: Alien le alur PUMI Nikho jong mala khan ni na ajing a, khan tha na thishen a jir rangnih.

english: And it shall come to pass That whoever calls on the name of the Lord Shall be saved.
chiru: Khan PUMI riming aban mi rikip kha shan rangnih, tia Pathien na ieriei.

english: Men of Israel, hear these words: Jesus of Nazareth, a Man attested by God to you by miracles, wonders, and signs which God did through Him in your midst, as you yourselves also know -
chiru: Aw Israel miring hai, chawng hai hi rangai u roh. Pathien na ama jar a nang kar ua iruthaw chonrekhek hai, rekhekchon hai le jetna hai kha rotokna a, mahi miring Nazareth Jesu hi irumuchuk nih joi. Nangnitak na mahi nangijet u inih.

english: Him, being delivered by the determined purpose and foreknowledge of God, you have taken by lawless hands, have crucified, and put to death;
chiru: Pathien na irumuchuksha le irujetsha dungjuia mahi miringpa hi nangni dieng inurupek u inih. Danishawnboi hai khut kha rotokna a cross ling ah nangruthat uh.

english: whom God raised up, having loosed the pains of death, because it was not possible that He should be held by it.
chiru: Pathien na thitna natna ah put ah rumoshok a rumiring joi, ajarla thitna ranak kha na ama ikhop rang a kha anithiei nimak.

english: For David says concerning Him: I foresaw the Lord always before my face, For He is at my right hand, that I may not be shaken.
chiru: Ajarla David na Jesu chungchanga ruti: PUMI kha kamaton a kumuk jawnjai. Ih kha na kiei hi nanawk ngam naw nih. Ajarla ama kha kukhut chang tieng awm.

english: Therefore my heart rejoiced, and my tongue was glad; Moreover my flesh also will rest in hope.
chiru: Khajarkhan kumulung na apar, khan kiemieliei na ningaidet. Kha khea kupum na ngakmining a ring rangnih.

english: For You will not leave my soul in Hades, Nor will You allow Your Holy One to see corruption.
chiru: Ajarla Thikho khan kiringphuk kha namak pe naw tinih, ninawkle nang Riethieng Akhat kha na omoro imuk rang a kha jawt pe naw tinih.

english: You have made known to me the ways of life; You will make me full of joy in Your presence.
chiru: Ringkho lam hai kha kiei dieng nangnumumuk joi. Kiei dieng a nangawm kha na mulungparna kha le nangnimiship joi.

english: Men and brethren, let me speak freely to you of the patriarch David, that he is both dead and buried, and his tomb is with us to this day.
chiru: Uliennai miring hai, phungpa David jar a lungartak a riei rawng, makhala ama kha ruthi a rukhum u joi. Ama than kha von nikhoshe hin kieini le awmlai.

english: Therefore, being a prophet, and knowing that God had sworn with an oath to him that of the fruit of his body, according to the flesh, He would raise up the Christ to sit on his throne,
chiru: Thiempulien `khat runit jarkhan, taksha dungjuia ama vawnchawi ara ah put ah Christa kha Pathien na mothoi a ama rengmun ah mushut rang, tia Pathien na riming ban a chawngirurakham pe kha David na rujet.

english: he, foreseeing this, spoke concerning the resurrection of the Christ, that His soul was not left in Hades, nor did His flesh see corruption.
chiru: Mahi rumukmasha jarkhan, David na Christa thoiretna jar a ruriei, makhala ama ringphuk kha Thikho khan rumak pe mak, khan ama taksha kha na`awm morona, iti kha rumuh mak.

english: This Jesus God has raised up, of which we are all witnesses.
chiru: Mahi Jesu hi Pathien na irumothoi inih. Mahi nokholok na kungnachang uh.

english: Therefore being exalted to the right hand of God, and having received from the Father the promise of the Holy Spirit, He poured out this which you now see and hear.
chiru: Pathien khut chang tieng rulawm a apa ah put ah chawngirurakham Ratha Riethieng kha ruman shole, tun a nangimuk u le nangijet u hi ama na ijongmephe nih joi.

english: For David did not ascend into the heavens, but he says himself: The Lord said to my Lord, Sit at My right hand,
chiru: Ajarla David na ravan tieng ruka mak, inia amatak na ruti, PUMI na kupumi dieng ruti, Nang rahapui hai kha nang kekhawng kamachang malalim, kukhut chang tieng shuh roh.

english: Till I make Your enemies Your footstool.
chiru: Nang rahapui hai kha nang kekhawng kamachang malalim.

english: Therefore let all the house of Israel know assuredly that God has made this Jesus, whom you crucified, both Lord and Christ.
chiru: Khajarkhan Israel inshung kholok na jet rosho, makhala cross ling ah nangiruthat u mahi Jesu hi Pumi le Christa dire kha iruminit inih.

english: Now when they heard this, they were cut to the heart, and said to Peter and the rest of the apostles, Men and brethren, what shall we do?
chiru: Amani na rujet u phakhan, amani mulung rushit pe ua Peter le tirtawn kholok dieng ruti uh, Uliennai miring hai, kieini na imaw thaw u ning?

english: Then Peter said to them, Repent, and let every one of you be baptized in the name of Jesus Christ for the remission of sins; and you shall receive the gift of the Holy Spirit.
chiru: Peter na amani dieng ruriei, Pathien na nang munu u kha arangaidamna rang, nang mulung lek u tana mi rikip na Jesu Christa riming a baptisma loi u roh. Khan Ratha Riethieng khutchawi kha nangmuk u rangnih.

english: For the promise is to you and to your children, and to all who are afar off, as many as the Lord our God will call.
chiru: Ajarla chawngrakham hi nangni rang le nang nai hai rang, khan latak ah awm hai rang le Pumi napathien na tukha nitjoiawm ikoi amani rang a inih.

english: And with many other words he testified and exhorted them, saying, Be saved from this perverse generation.
chiru: Nangni ashie hi rong ah put ah rekhe u roh, tia chawng tampui le chawng rupek a rumawshawk uh.

english: Then those who gladly received his word were baptized; and that day about three thousand souls were added to them.
chiru: Khan ningaitak a ama chawng aloi hai kha na baptisma ruloi uh. Makha nikhotak khan miring bawp `thum hi irubo inih.

english: And they continued steadfastly in the apostles' doctrine and fellowship, in the breaking of bread, and in prayers.
chiru: Amani na tirtawn hai ruchukna le rawlawpna, shakriethieng shakna le nikna khan mulung rupek uh.

english: Then fear came upon every soul, and many wonders and signs were done through the apostles.
chiru: Mi rikip chung a ratharakakna jong shok, ajarla tirtawn hai na rekhekchon le jetna tampui kha ruthaw uh.

english: Now all who believed were together, and had all things in common,
chiru: Takashawn kholok na lawp `khat a ruawm ua, nieinak kholok rureshem uh.

english: and sold their possessions and goods, and divided them among all, as anyone had need.
chiru: Iniei u inleloi le nieinak kholok kha rujor ua, irangai u dungjuia amani dieng rupek uh.

english: So continuing daily with one accord in the temple, and breaking bread from house to house, they ate their food with gladness and simplicity of heart,
chiru: Nikhonikho a riethiengmun ah mulung pum `khat a ruruchun uh. In rikip ah tan rukhoi uh, khan rawshaw le mulung renem a nekleshak kha rushak uh.

english: praising God and having favor with all the people. And the Lord added to the church daily those who were being saved.
chiru: Amani na Pathien kha rumapak uh, khan miring kholok le riengieihiem a ruawm uh. Ishan miring hai kha Pumi na nikhonikho a biekrup khan rubo a ruawm.
